name: Minggu Wang
headline: Building reliable AI through evaluation, generation, and testing.
summary: I study how AI systems generate, perceive, and fail—from quantum code generation to image editing and autonomous-driving robustness.
research: AI for software engineering, generative vision, and robustness evaluation.
collaboration: Open to research collaborations in AI evaluation, code generation, computer vision, and dependable intelligent systems.
current: Connecting benchmark design, generative models, and system-level robustness testing through measurable and reproducible research.
